_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Snapshot compiled 2026-09-26 from cited public records and reporting. Legal statuses and roles are time-bound to the cited source dates; allegations are identified as charges. Public senior figures only, with country-level regions; no operational route or enforcement-weakness information. No photos included because reliable reuse licenses and credits were not verified.
